name: pi-loop-engineering
description: From Prompt Engineering to Loop Engineering for Physical AI.

interface.shortDescription: From Prompt Engineering to Loop Engineering for Physical AI.
interface.longDescription: PI Loop Engineering (PI = Physical AI) turns prompts into controlled engineering loops with H0/H1 harnesses, bounded Sub-agent dispatch, risk-adaptive independent Review, immutable Final Handoff, separately authorized Release, and proposal-only Knowledge Evolution. The committed runtime is Node.js JavaScript ESM only.
defaultPrompt: $loop-engineering — Bootstrap, harness, implement, review, and hand off a Physical AI coding loop.
$status — inspect Loop state without changing it.
$release — assess Final Handoff readiness or perform an authorized release action.
$knowledge-evolution — propose improvements from completed Handoffs and Releases.
